run_train_consistency_model: run the consistency training script to train a consistency model from scratch on an image dataset
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse command-line arguments for consistency model training configuration
run_get_karras_sigmas: run the get_karras_sigmas function to calculate Karras sigma timestep discretization for a given number of steps
run_get_discretization_steps: run the get_discretization_steps function to calculate discretization steps using the curriculum N(k) over training
run_log_validation: run the log_validation function to generate and log sample images from the trained consistency model
